summary: Your data reaches ServiceNow sooner, and the monthly review mail is sent again.

fixes.title: ServiceNow receives data sooner
fixes.text: Sending to ServiceNow and your other systems now starts as soon as the newest findings are stored, without waiting for the rest. A resend takes minutes.

fixes.title: Monthly review mail is sent again
fixes.text: The technical owners' monthly review mail is sent again. It stopped in the two previous versions.

fixes.title: Old data removed in the background
fixes.text: Old collections are removed a little at a time while nothing else runs, with progress in the status. The newest two complete collections are always kept.
